label: Onboarding completeness
rationale: Below 95% a document or a mandate is missing; below 80% the client cannot be served in full.

label: Digital adoption
rationale: Share of the last 12 months with an active login: clients who use the app call less and stay longer.

label: Service tickets open
rationale: Two open tickets is ordinary service; past five the client is waiting on us.

label: Net promoter score
rationale: The client's last survey answer, scaled −100 to 100: 30 and up is a promoter book, below zero a detractor.

label: Complaints, last 90 days
rationale: Any complaint is a signal; a second one in a quarter is a pattern.

label: Pipeline cover
rationale: Open pipeline against the year's revenue target: three times cover absorbs the usual win rate.

label: Win rate
rationale: Share of closed opportunities won over 12 months.

label: New money against target
rationale: Net new money so far this year against the target pro rata to October.

label: Products added this year
rationale: Each new product line deepens the relationship; none in ten months means the book is static.

label: Days since the last meeting
rationale: A meeting every six weeks keeps a relationship warm; three months of silence is a gap.

label: Meetings held against plan
rationale: Meetings held this year against the coverage plan, pro rata.

label: Relationship manager load
rationale: Clients in the RM's book against the clients the RM can cover well; past capacity, every client gets less.

label: Annual review overdue
rationale: Days past the annual review date: a month is tolerable, more is a compliance and service risk.

label: Share of wallet, 12-month change
rationale: A flat or rising share of the client's wallet holds; a drop of more than three points means money is going elsewhere.

label: Attrition risk
rationale: Model score 0 to 100 from flows, logins, complaints and tenure; above 60 a third of such clients leave within a year.

label: Fee leakage
rationale: Fees waived or discounted outside the rate card, as a share of fees due.

label: Days to the KYC refresh
rationale: Days until the client's KYC file must be refreshed; below zero it is overdue and the account can be restricted.

label: Sentiment in notes
rationale: Tone of the last six months of call notes, −1 to 1.
